title: Homesite Reservation Premium Classes and Lot Premium Bands
content:
Every homesite offered under a Homesite Reservation carries the premium class that the community site plan assigns it. The class is fixed by the site plan, and each class covers a band of lot premiums running from a lowest to a highest lot premium in US dollars.

## Class schedule

| Rank | Premium class (official name) | Site plan class | Lowest lot premium | Highest lot premium |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Interior Homesite | interior | USD 0 | USD 4999 |
| 2 | Corner Homesite | corner | USD 5000 | USD 12499 |
| 3 | Cul-de-Sac Homesite | cul-de-sac | USD 12500 | USD 19999 |
| 4 | Greenbelt Homesite | greenbelt | USD 20000 | USD 39999 |
| 5 | Water-View Homesite | water view | USD 40000 | USD 74999 |
| 6 | Golf-Frontage Homesite | golf frontage | USD 75000 | USD 165000 |

## Notes on the schedule

- The lowest and highest figures are the lowest and highest lot premium of a homesite assigned to that class, so a lot premium equal to either figure belongs to the band.
- The premium class name in the first column is the name printed on the reservation record of a Homesite Reservation and is the name every class-based term of the product refers to.
- The rank orders the classes from Interior Homesite (1) to Golf-Frontage Homesite (6); it states no rule of its own.

## Reading the bands (hypothetical lots)

| Hypothetical lot premium | Band it falls in |
|---|---|
| USD 19999 | Cul-de-Sac Homesite (its highest figure) |
| USD 20000 | Greenbelt Homesite (its lowest figure) |
| USD 0 | Interior Homesite (its lowest figure) |
